recipeCatalog.summary: Deterministic scalar, categorical, and temporal rows.
Ordered low/high or start/end rows with closed interval invariants.
Deterministic OHLCV rows that preserve candle and volume invariants.
Deterministic positive-weight relationship edges with stable identities.
Deterministic rooted hierarchy nodes with stable parent identities.
Deterministic two-dimensional grid or raster rows.
Non-negative three-part compositions with a strictly positive total.
Consistent set cardinalities derived from bounded aggregate membership rows.
Deterministic finite voxel values and dimensions.
Deterministic finite vector origins and components.
